original_query: select    min(s_store_name)   ,min(s_company_id)   ,min(s_street_number)   ,min(s_street_name)   ,min(s_suite_number)   ,min(s_city)   ,min(s_zip)   ,min(ss_ticket_number)   ,min(ss_sold_date_sk)   ,min(sr_returned_date_sk)   ,min(ss_item_sk)   ,min(d1.d_date_sk) from    store_sales   ,store_returns   ,store   ,date_dim d1   ,date_dim d2 where     d2.d_moy = 2 and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk   = d1.d_date_sk and sr_returned_date_sk   = d2.d_date_sk and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and sr_store_sk = s_store_sk and d1.d_date between (d2.d_date - interval '120' day)                and d2.d_date and d1.d_dow = 4 and s_state in ('MI','NC','WI')  ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    MIN(s.s_store_name)         AS s_store_name,
    MIN(s.s_company_id)         AS s_company_id,
    MIN(s.s_street_number)      AS s_street_number,
    MIN(s.s_street_name)        AS s_street_name,
    MIN(s.s_suite_number)       AS s_suite_number,
    MIN(s.s_city)               AS s_city,
    MIN(s.s_zip)                AS s_zip,
    MIN(ss.ss_ticket_number)    AS ss_ticket_number,
    MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk)     AS ss_sold_date_sk,
    MIN(sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS sr_returned_date_sk,
    MIN(ss.ss_item_sk)          AS ss_item_sk,
    MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk)     AS d1_d_date_sk
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
 AND d2.d_moy = 2
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk       = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_customer_sk   = sr.sr_customer_sk
 AND ss.ss_store_sk      = sr.sr_store_sk
 AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN sr.sr_returned_date_sk - 120 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
 AND d1.d_dow = 4
WHERE s.s_state IN ('MI','NC','WI');

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Converted implicit comma joins into explicit ANSI JOINs, placing all fact-to-fact equality conditions (ticket, item, customer, store) in the store_sales–store_returns join.

Replaced the date/interval range predicate d1.d_date BETWEEN d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY AND d2.d_date with the equivalent integer predicate ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN sr_returned_date_sk - 120 AND sr_returned_date_sk, since date_dim.d_date_sk is a sequential day key in TPC-DS. This removes the cross-dimension range join (d1 vs d2) and applies cheap integer filtering directly in the fact join.

Removed the redundant ss_store_sk = s_store_sk condition: it is transitively implied by ss_store_sk = sr_store_sk and sr_store_sk = s_store_sk. Dimension filters (d2.d_moy = 2, d1.d_dow = 4, s_state IN) are attached to their respective joins/WHERE for early filtering.
Replaced MIN(d1.d_date_sk) with MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk), since ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk; this removes d1 from the SELECT output while retaining d1 solely for the d_dow = 4 filter.
